'''Marcus Certa''' was Decipher [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]] Red 5 in Burlington, Vermont.<ref name="smlist" /> The slot is marked Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.<ref name="smlist" /> He was a frequent [[Radio Free Decipher]] guest in 1999.<ref name="rfd" />

Decipher recruited volunteer Squadron Members in the 1990s to promote SWCCG locally (tournaments, demos, player support).

== Radio Free Decipher ==

Certa appeared on broadcasts 5, 19, 21 and 22 in 1999, discussing SWCCG and Young Jedi organized play.<ref name="rfd">[[Radio Free Decipher]] broadcasts 5, 19, 21 and 22 (1999)</ref>
